decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 
1/ The proposed erection of a  new shop, would, by reason of its size, position and appearance  in relation to the shopping parade, be unduly obtrusive, intrusive and  out of scale  and character, detrimental to the visual amenities of the adjoining occupiers of this parade of shops and the streetscene and is contrary to the Policies ENV 1.1 (All New Development) and S 4.2 (Shop front design) of the Unitary Development Plan and ENVB 1.1 (New Development) and S 4.2 (Shop front design) of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan.     

2/ The proposed erection of a  new shop, would not serve to provide adequate 
means of access to to the premises for people with disabilities and is contrary to the 
Policy S 4.5 (Access to Shopping Facilities) of the Unitary Development Plan and 
Policy S 4.4 (Access to Shopping Facilities) of the Revised Deposit Unitary 
Development Plan. 

3/ The proposal , by reason of insufficient car parking arrangements, would lead to 
an unsatisfactory development of the site, likely to give rise to and exacerbate the  
extant indiscriminate kerbside parking that occurs at and within the viciniyty of the 
site, which in turn would be detrimental to the safety and free flow of traffic and 
pedestrian safety and be contrary to policies T 2.5 - (Parking and Servicing Facilities 
for Developments) of the Unitary Development Plan and  T 1.4 (Car and Cycle  
Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Revised Deposit Unitary 
Development Plan.
